remarks:
Welcome to 121 Payne! This home still retains the majestic qualities it had when it was constructed at the turn of the 20th century. Boasting 2,500 square feet of living space, with 5 bedrooms, 1 full and 2 half bathrooms, and an attic that can easily be converted into additional living space. With a little hard work and imagination, this home can be restored to a modern mansion, while keeping the integrity of traditional architecture. Original hardwood flooring, leaded and stained glass windows, vintage light fixtures, and paneled antique doors are just some of the charming accents throughout the home. Walk up the front steps and into the enclosed sunroom, complete with walls of windows letting in bright, natural light. French doors lead you into the vast living room/family room, a fantastic space for entertaining. The formal dining room boasts exquisite wainscoting and built-in hutch, and leads into the eat-in kitchen and walk-in butler's pantry.  Office  and powder room on 1st floor. Upstairs, are four more bedrooms and the full bathroom. The primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet and bonus room, perfect as studio, home office, playroom, or home gym. Stairs take you up to the full attic, unfinished but with so much potential! Full sized windows with flooring and framing already in place. The basement is partially finished and includes a bonus half bath. Outside, the fully fenced-in backyard has beautiful landscaping and two sheds for additional storage.
This home is a must see! Open houses Saturday 10/10 from 10-2 and Sunday 10/11 from 1-3. Negotiations begin Monday October 19th at noon.
